evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and directly modifies legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration logic and transaction cleanup callbacks.
rationale: Fixes complete migration failure for legacy watch-only wallets without spendable keys. As documented in #36483, migration for these wallets fails with 'Error: Not all transaction records were migrated (-4)' masked by 'std::bad_function_call', preventing users from completing legacy-to-descriptor migration.
